context: Two classmates catch up after school
purpose: Catch up as peers; teach 呼ん/帰宅/だり/刺激/うえ/矛盾/堂/起こし

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: さっき呼んだの、ノート借りたくて。
lines.en: I called you earlier to borrow your notes.
lines.style: casual teen explaining his quick request

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: いいよ。今日、帰宅部のくせに遅かったね。
lines.en: Sure. You were late for a go-straight-home type today.
lines.style: teasing teen ribbing her friend, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 図書館で読んだり調べたりしてたんだ。
lines.en: I was reading and researching at the library.
lines.style: mildly proud teen defending himself, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: へえ、珍しい。何かいい刺激でもあった？
lines.en: Huh, rare. Did you get some good stimulation?
lines.style: surprised teen prodding playfully, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 先輩の話を聞いたうえで、進路を考え直した。
lines.en: After hearing a senior’s talk, I rethought my path.
lines.style: earnest teen revealing a shift, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: その話、前に聞いたのと矛盾してない？
lines.en: Doesn’t that contradict what you said before?
lines.style: sharp teen catching the inconsistency, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: まあ、人は変わるんだよ。公会堂の講演がきっかけ。
lines.en: Well, people change. A talk at the public hall did it.
lines.style: breezy teen brushing off the jab

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 明日寝坊しないでよ。もう起こしてあげないからね。
lines.en: Don’t oversleep tomorrow. I won’t wake you anymore.
lines.style: mock-stern teen issuing a warning, voice clear and distinctly their own
